linux-exit-137-oom.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed, blind second-model review; pending independent human review
linux-exit-137-oom.learning_objective: Diagnose resource and permission failures on production hosts.

distractor_rationale.a: SIGTERM would usually give 143 (128 + 15), and the kernel log names the OOM killer.
distractor_rationale.c: A segmentation fault is signal 11, so 139.
distractor_rationale.d: SIGSTOP pauses; it does not end the process.

follow_up_questions: In a container, why might the OOM kill happen while the host still has free memory?
